name: The Noric Republic's air force
description: A small neutral neighbour in a limited border war: some forty light jets with rockets, gun pods and small bombs, two dozen armed utility helicopters, a squadron of gun-armed interceptors. It supports its own troops along the line and raids what is close to the front, short, low and fast, at first and last light. Little reconnaissance, a border ELINT station or two, observers along the border. Every aircraft is irreplaceable and the war is meant to stay small.
source: austrian_af_wiki (the shape of a small neutral air arm of the 1980s: 40 light jets delivered from 1970, about two dozen utility helicopters from 1980, interceptors with guns only under a ban on guided missiles); every number a game value
notes: The Noric Republic is fictional. Nothing here is Austrian data: the analogue only gives the scale and the limits. Every aircraft number is a PLACEHOLDER.

doctrine.source: game values: a territorial-defence doctrine shaped like austrian_af_wiki's air arm (support of the own troops, raids near the front)

armed_recce.notes: Pairs of light jets searching the roads near the line for convoys.

strike.notes: Four light jets, low and fast; a pair of interceptors over them when the defender's fighters are about.

intelligence.source: game values: border observers, a ground ELINT station or two, camera pods on the light jets

logistics.notes: buildup: a small mobilised air force, all there from the start
logistics.source: game values: a small air arm with no reserve of aircraft and no anti-radiation missiles

politics.source: game values: a neutral state's limited war aim (front-line targets only, nothing deep, nothing that kills civilians). The nation's infrastructure kinds (refinery to exchange, 22 Oct 2026) are game values by analogy; a kind of the power grid (substation, dam) is banned wherever power_plant is. The refinery, the ministries and broadcasting are banned with the factories and headquarters: nothing that is the state itself. The pipeline stations too: the smaller line carries its own oil, which it stops at the valve when the war begins (docs/campaign/10_BRIEFING_FORCES_AND_NATION.md §3.1), so there is nothing to gain in bombing it (the nation's theatre's first read, 22 Oct 2026)

events.name: Mediation
events.text: A neutral mediator brings both sides to the table: the raids pause for a day.

events.name: Deeper raids authorised
events.text: The government lets the air force strike up to 60 km behind the line.

events.name: Losses at home
events.text: Two aircraft lost in a day: parliament demands the raids be flown above the light flak.

aircraft.name: Light attack jet (Saab 105 class)
aircraft.source: austrian_af_wiki (40 Saab 105 light jets, trainer and light attack, delivered from 1970); every number a placeholder

aircraft.name: Armed utility helicopter (AB 212 class)
aircraft.source: austrian_af_wiki (about two dozen Agusta-Bell 212, from 1980); armed here for the game; numbers placeholders

aircraft.name: Gun-armed interceptor (Draken class)
aircraft.source: austrian_af_wiki (Draken interceptors with guns only under the ban on guided missiles; delivered 1988, later than this war, so here an analogue); numbers placeholders

aircraft.name: Liaison and observation helicopter (Alouette III class)
aircraft.source: austrian_af_wiki (Alouette III for rescue and liaison); numbers placeholders

officers.name: Leopold Hainisch
officers.background: Light-jet pilot, then twenty years on the staff
officers.bio: A diplomat in uniform. Knows the government wants this war small and short, and that every aircraft lost is one the country cannot replace.

officers.name: Ernst Pichler
officers.background: Former leader of the light-jet display team
officers.bio: Flies his raids like a display: low over the hills at first light, to the second.

officers.name: Rudolf Moser
officers.background: Officer of the border observation service
officers.bio: Knows every farm track along the border; knows little beyond it.

officers.name: Walter Steiner
officers.bio: Can put a helicopter behind a single tree. Leads every raid himself.
